[[File:Eshkrene_mammal_species.jpg|200px|thumb|This unidentified mammalian species inhabited Eskhrene]]
The planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] southern polar continent of [[Eshkrene]] was home to a non-sentient '''mammalian species'''. These mammals were covered in a thick grey fur coat with black stripes. They were known to have four legs and a large bushy tail. They also had two sets of eyes, ears, a black nose, and several black whiskers. One member of this species was seen by members of an [[Alanciari]] expedition which discovered Eshkrene in [[2974 BBY]]. This expedition had been sent by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], which had embarked on a maritime exploration program to explore and conquer the rest of Kesh.
